stages.name: governance_recovery
stages.scientific_question: Can the project be governed, recovered and audited without chat memory?
stages.pass_condition: Recovery/governance objects validate and another session can reconstruct the front.
stages.fail_condition: A frozen governance contradiction is demonstrated.
stages.invalid_condition: Provenance or state semantics are malformed.

stages.name: requirements_failure_mode_closure
stages.scientific_question: Are theory-neutral obligations and failure modes sufficiently explicit to constrain construction?
stages.pass_condition: Failure-mode map, anti-patterns, claim locks and required comparator classes are explicit.
stages.blocked_condition: External methodological interface required but not pinned.
stages.invalid_condition: Benchmark outcomes are imported as construction targets.

stages.name: ontology
stages.scientific_question: Is a minimal microscopic ontology explicitly defined with falsifiable structure?
stages.pass_condition: State space, variables, symmetries, composition concept, geometry observable mechanism, dynamics source, freedom estimate and cheap falsifiers are explicit.
stages.fail_condition: Proposed ontology contradicts a frozen mandatory requirement.
stages.blocked_condition: One or more required ontology objects are missing.
stages.invalid_condition: Ontology was retuned after benchmark outcome inspection.

stages.name: dynamics
stages.scientific_question: Is the smallest explicit dynamics/amplitude/generator/measure defined and prospectively controlled?
stages.pass_condition: Dynamics, symmetry, dimensional analysis, parameter count and regulator/extension policy satisfy the frozen contract.
stages.fail_condition: Dynamics violates a frozen consistency requirement.
stages.blocked_condition: Dynamics or required quantum object is absent.
stages.invalid_condition: Post-hoc terms or benchmark-specific tuning are detected.
stages.claim_ceiling: Candidate dynamics only; not theory establishment.

stages.name: local_mathematical_closure
stages.scientific_question: Is the candidate mathematically/physically well defined enough for expensive phenomenology?
stages.pass_condition: Applicable closure, composition, normalization, extension, causality and physical-state obligations have terminal evidence.
stages.fail_condition: A decisive scoped mathematical contradiction is established.
stages.invalid_condition: Infrastructure error or unsupported theorem transfer is treated as science.
stages.claim_ceiling: Local closure only; no global theorem unless separately proved.

stages.name: same_realization_uv_ir_transport
stages.scientific_question: Does one identified realization connect microscopic data to an IR Lorentzian realization?
stages.pass_condition: Identity chain and controlled UV->IR map validate without realization substitution.
stages.fail_condition: A frozen identity link is inconsistent.
stages.blocked_condition: A required map or uncertainty object is missing.
stages.invalid_condition: A different realization is substituted downstream.

stages.name: gr_recovery
stages.scientific_question: Does the same realization derive a controlled 4D Lorentzian GR regime or bounded deformation?
stages.pass_condition: Domain, effective equations/action, Newton/cosmological maps, corrections, remainder/error and provenance are derived.
stages.fail_condition: Derived IR equations contradict the preregistered GR criterion.
stages.blocked_condition: A required map/domain/error bound is missing.
stages.invalid_condition: GR is inserted by definition or from another realization.

stages.name: normalized_observable
stages.scientific_question: Is at least one normalized observable defined end-to-end on a common domain with propagated uncertainty?
stages.pass_condition: UV and operational IR observable, normalization, common domain, parameter identity, uncertainty and comparator representation validate.
stages.fail_condition: A frozen observable prediction contradicts the comparison criterion.
stages.invalid_condition: Formal unnormalized quantity is promoted as an observable.

stages.name: frozen_independent_benchmark_export
stages.scientific_question: Can a versioned native QGR candidate be exported to the frozen independent KMQGB/RQIR interface without benchmark mutation?
stages.pass_condition: Native export validates, adapter is loss-audited, KMQGB record validates and interface pin has no drift.
stages.fail_condition: Independent frozen benchmark produces a scientific FAIL under its rules.
stages.invalid_condition: Adapter mutates benchmark semantics or converts BLOCKED to PASS.

stages.name: prediction_discrimination
stages.scientific_question: Does the candidate produce a prediction, exclusion surface or structural theorem not inserted as reconstruction input?
stages.pass_condition: A falsifiable discriminator with provenance and non-input audit is established.
stages.fail_condition: Frozen discriminator fails its comparison test.
stages.blocked_condition: No non-input discriminator is yet available.
stages.invalid_condition: Input condition is relabeled as prediction.
